quests.title: Childhood Happiness

dialogue.t: It's nothing. Belsky's just doing some sledding.
He's always wanted to try dog sledding... Unfortunately, his dad, Bystrov, is always busy looking for work, so I'm filling in for him.
He'll be fine. Whistle is a strong dog, and even took some training from Tugarin. There shouldn't be any problems.
Besides, every kid has to face danger on their own sooner or later. He's better off doing it with someone watching over him.
You bet! This is fun! Can I do ten more laps?
Haha... As far as he's concerned, this isn't dangerous at all.

quests.description: You hear a joyful voice coming from outside the shelter on the snowy plains…
